title: Barndominium Living in Belton Texas
description:
Where Country Soul Meets Refined Living — 26 Acres on the Lampasas River

Welcome to a rare Central Texas retreat—26 private acres of Lampasas River frontage just minutes from Belton and Salado. Behind a gated private drive, a modern barndominium blends upscale finishes with authentic Texas charm.

🏞 Property Highlights:
• 26 acres of Lampasas River frontage
• Private gated drive through mature trees
• Modern barndominium with chef’s kitchen, ZLINE gas range + quartz counters
• Sparkling pool + pool house with kitchenette and full bath
• Private fishing hole on the river
• Equestrian amenities: fenced paddock, round pen, tack room, and chicken coop
• Prime location near I-35—secluded and quiet, yet close to shopping, dining, and healthcare

This is more than land—it’s your Lampasas River legacy.
